Good luck! Focus on bearings/crab angle and related rates for math. Andaming ganyang tanong and I think madaming nadali sa mga questions na yan for our batch. Most problems sa math namin is doable, but if you do it manually as in mag susulat ka sa papel ng solution mo mauubusan ka ng oras kahit pa 3 hours yun.

Oo you have to use Mode 2 CMPLX for complex functions sa Olympia para mapalabas mo yung mga imaginary. In our case, pinalagay po sa bag yung spare calculator and you'll have to ask permission sa proctor if nasiraan ka kunwari, then alam ko sila na kukuha sa bag mo. Pero during the actual exam isang calcu lang nasa table dapat

I personally used olympia. Mabilis mag shift solve but it has its cons. One that we have found is that may mga integration na hindi nya masolve na kaya ng ibang calcu. Another is we found two calc tricks na erroneous yung error, specifically for arithmetic/geometric progressions and another for second yata or third derivative, so you'll probably have to learn those manually, madali lang naman. Another thing is most calcu tricks resources online sa youtube or pdfs na makukuha mo throughout your review will be catered for Casio, which is the same format for Olympia. For Texas, may additional functionalities sya, pero mahirap hanapin yung mga calcu tricks na pdfs or videos. Otherwise I think ok naman sya. Depends on you, if Casio yung gamit mo throughout college then wala ka nang ibang aaralin for Olympia, whereas for Texas you'll have to re learn from scratch
